gen-gf-autour-one-gf-tiktok-sans: Expressive and loud, Autour One runs a clear channel into every round letter, with barely any step from capitals to lowercase. And TikTok Sans follows with a tall x-height and a spacious c, so a long passage reads smooth and modern.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-ubuntu-sans: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-thin strokes of uniform width, with c tips held well apart. Ubuntu Sans adds lowercase eyes as big as washers and tubular strokes, so the two feel like thread meeting copper pipe.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving generous gaps between its curve ends and stems. Grandstander is best at being loud and open, while Bespoke Sans is best at staying precise once the shouting stops.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-abeezee: Short ascenders and a tall x-height give Grandstander its stubby, plain-lined punch. But ABeeZee goes down easily over a long passage, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem like neon glass tubing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-aldrich: Grandstander is all constant-width lines and letters held open rather than curled shut. Aldrich sans-serif brings the strongest quality of the pair, cupped round letters and a high x-height that feel like tracing one thick thread.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-alexandria: Chunky, open and unfussy, Grandstander traces its letters like a laser-etched line of one width. And Alexandria answers with wide c terminals and a tall body, while Grandstander earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-amiko: Grandstander gives its lowercase n an arch and stem that match, all in plain constant-width lines. Amiko, by contrast, does its best work as sturdy text, with crayon-tall strokes and terminals pointing outward like tongs.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-bangla: Round letters with walls as heavy as the straight ones give Grandstander a sturdy, cord-like presence on top. Anek Bangla then reads easy and contemporary, with wide s curves.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-devanagari: Bold and expressive, Grandstander makes curves as heavy as its stems, like cord. Anek Devanagari's open letter mouths and tall middle zone are the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-anek-gujarati: Wire-cut strokes, bold and open. Grandstander leads with short ascenders and a tall x-height, while Anek Gujarati follows with a lowercase that rivals the capitals and a gaping c opening.
